ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which animal is prey to the snake?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is a food web. Near the upper left, there is an animal labeled "Snake." Near the center, there is an animal labeled "Mouse." An arrow is drawn from the mouse toward the snake, pointing into/toward the snake. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually show energy flow from prey to predator, meaning the organism at the arrow tail is eaten by the organism at the arrow head. Since the arrow goes from Mouse to Snake, the mouse is prey to the snake.
